assumptions.engine: real store and battle engine; current auto-skill order
assumptions.timing: 520ms round / speed, min 60ms; passive next 12s; caretaker next/restart 2s; boon 5s
assumptions.passive: no summons, equipment, pets, quests, bond upgrades or restarts after death
assumptions.caretaker: summon to six; raise affordable bonds; five pets; best gear by power; salvage leftovers; enhance to +5; claim quests; restart after death
assumptions.exclusions: no training, shop, upgrades, dungeons, sweeps, daily refresh, latency or time spent navigating menus
assumptions.clocks: deterministic simulated elapsed time; no waiting; saves are reset between runs
